historyPolicy: Published claims are not silently rewritten when their evidence/scope becomes obsolete. Mark them superseded or withdrawn and publish a new claim ID or reviewed revision with explicit lineage.

statusMeaning.verified: Reviewed claim backed by direct primary/internal evidence sufficient for the stated scope.
statusMeaning.reviewed: Human-reviewed claim whose evidence is useful but does not justify verified status.
statusMeaning.experimental: Provisional claim retained for testing or investigation.
statusMeaning.superseded: Historical claim replaced by a newer claim; retained for auditability.
statusMeaning.withdrawn: Claim no longer supported; retained with history instead of deleted.
